description: Edit one of your multiple-choice questions: question text, options, correct answer (letter A-E) or the explanation of the correct answer. Pass question_id = data.items[].id from the create_mcq result. Requires sign-in; you can only edit your own questions.

explanation.description: Updated explanation shown for the correct answer

options.description: Updated answer options, in order A, B, C, D (and optionally E). Provide 4 or 5 options.

question_id.description: The UUID from 'data.items[].id' field in create_mcq response. MUST be from the actual response, not invented.

name: edit_mcq
title: Edit Multiple-Choice Question
